verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe a built-in chat interface in its desktop app, used with locally downloaded models. Blog notes cover GUI chat features such as chat folders, regeneration paging, document attachment and themes. Community users independently confirm the UI for chatting with models, though some report UI rough edges such as no clear empty state. Missing for 10: polished-UX corroboration (community reports minor chat UI issues).

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Use a simple and flexible chat interface
Download the latest local LLMs directly within the app and use them for simple chats or advanced agentic tasks.
Now clicking "regenerate" keeps previous message generations and you can easily page between them using a familiar arrow right / arrow left interface.
a UI to chat with models easily
